Woh Lamhe, Jo Sirf Hamare Hain…

“Aapki Woh Kuch Khaas Baatein, Jinmein Mera Dil Sukoon Paata Hai…” ♥️🫂✨

Aapka mera khayal rakhna, chahe main kahun ya na kahun. ♥️

Aapka meri har chhoti-chhoti baaton ko yaad rakhna. 🎀

Aapka mujhe samajhna. 🫂

Aapki awaaz mein woh sukoon jo kahin aur nahi milta. ✨

Aapka mujhe special feel karwana. ♥️

Aapki muskurahat, jo mera din achha bana deti hai. 🎀

Aapka gussa bhi, kyunki usmein bhi apnapan chhupa hota hai. 🫂

Aapka mere saath rehna, achhe aur mushkil dono waqt mein. ♥️

Aapke saath har chhoti cheez ka yaadgaar ban jaana. ✨

Aapka sirf mere favourite hona hi nahi, balke meri zindagi ka sabse pyaara hissa hona. 🎀

Aap mujhe itni achhi tarah samajhte hain ki kabhi-kabhi mujhe apni baat kehne ki bhi zaroorat nahi padti. 🫂

Aap meri khamoshi, meri narazgi aur mere chehre ke peeche chhupe ehsaas samajh lete hain. ♥️

Aap jaante hain mujhe kab pyaar se manana hai aur kab bas apne paas bithakar tasalli deni hai. 🎀

Aap meri har chhoti-chhoti khwahishon ko bhi ahmiyat dete hain. ✨

Aapke saath mujhe apna bachpana, apni zid aur apni har feeling bina jhijhak dikhane ka haq mehsoos hota hai. 🫂

Aap sirf meri baatein nahi sunte, unke peeche chhupe mere ehsaas bhi samajhte hain. ♥️

Aapke saath mujhe mohabbat ke saath apnapan aur apnepan ke saath sukoon milta hai. ✨

Aapki Har Baat Mere Liye Khaas Hai ♥️🫂✨

Meri jaan, aap mein itni saari khoobiyan hain aur aapki itni saari baatein hain jo mujhe aapse beinteha mohabbat karne ki wajah deti hain ki main chaah kar bhi unhein gin nahi sakti. Agar aapki har achhi baat ko likhne baith jaun, toh shayad lafz khatam ho jaayenge, lekin aapki tareef kabhi khatam nahi hogi. Aapki har chhoti-badi baat mere liye khaas hai. ♥️🫂✨

Hamare ishq ki haseen daastaan♥️✨
